department: College of Computing and Informatics, Computer Science track

deadline.value: To get full consideration for financial support, applications must be received by February 1 for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: applications must be received by September 1 for Spring admission and February 1 for Fall admission

gre_general.value: The CS track lists excellent GRE or GMAT scores as an admission requirement; the fetched page states no waiver.

gre_subject.value: The CS Subject GRE is optional: a satisfactory score can satisfy some prerequisite coursework.
gre_subject.quote: satisfactory score on the Computer Science Subject GRE examination

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to contact faculty with similar research interests before applying.
supervisor.quote: It is recommended that applicants contact faculty with similar research interests prior to submitting an application

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree from a recognised institution is the minimum; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree from a recognized institution

notes: This is the CS track only. The SIS track page lists a paper-based TOEFL 557 (old scale), not recorded. The page states no CS funding rule.
name: Computing and Information Systems, Ph.D. (CS track)
